title: Independent settings screenshot UI review

viewport.note: Parent captured native Tauri window screenshots. App chrome is included; content height is smaller than the complete image.

provenance.method: Independent read-only view_image inspection of screenshots 26 through 37; relevant source checked only to distinguish normal scrolling and click-through overlays from defects.
provenance.claims: Findings describe visible screenshot states only. This file does not claim every action, persistence, external service or physical device passed.

findings.title: Success notifications cover settings content and header actions
findings.observed: Themes screenshot shows four stacked success notifications covering the upper-right theme cards. Button Setup screenshot shows a save notification across the upper-right header-action area. The affected text and controls are visually hidden while the notification is displayed.
findings.scope: Visual occlusion is confirmed. General button click blocking is not claimed: notification stack and cards use pointer-events:none; only notification dismiss buttons receive pointer events.
findings.suggestion: Coalesce repeated configuration-save notifications or use a compact status location that leaves active settings controls visible. Preserve click-through behavior.

findings.title: Unchecked barcode digit is labelled Valid
findings.observed: Validate check digit is switched off, the tester input is 2312345006997, and the result still reports Check digit: Valid. The diagram's generated check digit is 8, not the entered final digit 7.
findings.scope: The accepted-rule result may be intended with validation disabled, but saying Valid falsely implies the checksum was checked and passed.
findings.suggestion: Show Not checked when checksum validation is disabled, or independently compute and display actual checksum validity without changing the configured acceptance rule.

inspectedScreenshots.result: Visual issue SET-VISUAL-01; otherwise visible card content fits the page width.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: Lower theme cards continue below the viewport in the visible scrollable page.

inspectedScreenshots.result: No genuine clipping, overlap or missing control found in the visible state.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: Top and bottom viewport cuts follow the current scroll position, not clipped card content.

inspectedScreenshots.result: Visual issue SET-VISUAL-01; all reorder rows and preview columns otherwise fit.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: Not needed for the currently visible rows.

inspectedScreenshots.result: UI-content issue SET-VISUAL-02; no layout overflow visible.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: No offscreen control is used as evidence of a defect.

inspectedScreenshots.result: No genuine clipping, overlap or missing control found in the visible state.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: Further connection controls continue below the viewport in the page scroll area.

inspectedScreenshots.visibleState: Modules tab with zero installed printer SDK modules; refresh and install actions.
inspectedScreenshots.result: All four tabs, module actions and empty-state text fit; no genuine UI issue visible.

inspectedScreenshots.visibleState: Design tab, Shelf template, size sliders, information toggles and selected-item label preview.
inspectedScreenshots.result: Reset, Save and Print actions, preview and visible design controls fit; no genuine UI issue visible.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: Print date controls continue below the left panel. Source .design-scroll has overflow-y:auto, so below-fold controls are not classified as missing.

inspectedScreenshots.visibleState: Content tab with ten visible content toggles and complete normal-size 80 mm receipt preview.
inspectedScreenshots.result: Header actions, content controls and preview fit; no genuine UI issue visible.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: Visible receipt fits the preview panel. Missing empty store fields cannot be diagnosed from this screenshot alone.

inspectedScreenshots.visibleState: Scrolled welcome-message settings with preview, saved status and disabled Save changes actions.
inspectedScreenshots.result: Visible inputs, colour controls, preview, Close/Open display and Save actions fit; no genuine UI issue visible.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: The welcome section heading is cut at the upper edge because the page has already scrolled.

inspectedScreenshots.visibleState: Scrolled scan/sale feedback cards, unsupported haptics state and four failed-barcode sound choices.
inspectedScreenshots.result: Visible card text, On/Off/Unavailable states and Test Barcode Alert action fit; no genuine clipping or overlap found.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: Earlier controls are above the current scroll position. Screenshot alone does not verify audible output.

inspectedScreenshots.visibleState: Dojo enabled, dedicated terminal assignment selected, old sandbox recovery action visible.
inspectedScreenshots.result: Header actions, provider state, assignment value and recovery action fit; no genuine UI issue visible.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: API access and assigned-terminal details continue below the current viewport.

inspectedScreenshots.visibleState: Scrolled blank credentials, unconfigured Solo reader, Not tested status and beginning of pairing section.
inspectedScreenshots.result: Credential fields, Find My Readers, reader placeholder and status fit; no genuine UI issue visible.
inspectedScreenshots.normalScrolling: Earlier fields and later pairing controls are outside the current scroll position. Disabled Test Reader is consistent with the visible unconfigured state.

limitations: These twelve screenshots show one native window size and selected scroll/tab states, not every combination of font size, theme, device mode or long text.
No conclusion about persistence, button response, remote API, sound, physical scale, printer or cash drawer is derived solely from a screenshot.
Scrollable content outside the captured viewport is not reported as inaccessible unless a scroll failure is separately reproduced.
No product source, running app, configuration, credentials, services or data were modified by this reviewer.
